corpus.description: anonymized realistic church-staff session prompts with adjudicated relevant skill ids

miss_examples: Can you get the staff update email ready for Friday?
Find me a room for the newcomer lunch that seats 40
Look up Jordan’s household in Planning Center

decision.justification: BM25 measurably improved recall and precision@5 on the same fixed replay; the Jaccard-scale absolute threshold was replaced by a corpus-relative cutoff. Verification showed 0.5 dropped a genuinely relevant secondary skill, so hand-derived multi-skill scores re-derived the cutoff to 0.45.

threshold_derivation.query: help me build the weekly staff report
threshold_derivation.reason: Both skills are adjudicated relevant; 0.45 retains the secondary while ordering and topN=5 remain unchanged.
threshold_derivation.replay_effect: Lowering the eligibility cutoff cannot change score ordering. All 12 relevant skills were already in the top five at 0.5, so recall@5 remains 1.0 and precision@5 remains 0.2.
